description: Two panels over the same earlier Pythia scan. The original eight addresses appear at left. At right, 48 qualified addresses are distributed as 24 locally mixed pairs, each containing a zero and a one, with rejected candidates shown as gray crosses. Circles and triangles distinguish the labels without relying only on color.

scope: Reproduced without modification. The left panel shows the earlier eight-address bank used for message transport. The right panel shows the separately qualified 48-address bank. Gray crosses retain excluded candidates. The background is the earlier scan, not newly measured short-window growth. Spatial mixing does not establish secrecy.
uncertainty: Reproduced raster; no new uncertainty or measurement inferred.
accessibility: Direct text labels and values; meanings do not rely only on color. PNG plots also have scalable SVG and PDF counterparts.
